summary: Replace padded all-to-all dispatch with packed variable-length dispatch to reduce communication overhead
rationale: Current padded dispatch wastes bandwidth sending empty slots (capacity * num_experts * ep_size)
Remote dispatch ratio is 0.9923, so reducing per-token communication is high leverage
Packed dispatch sends only assigned tokens, reducing estimated_a2a_bytes proportionally to sparsity
Preserves top-2 routing semantics and all benchmark metrics
expected_effects: Reduce step_time_s by 15-25% through lower all-to-all communication volume
Reduce estimated_a2a_bytes proportionally to token assignment sparsity
Maintain identical tokens_dropped, tokens_rerouted, and load_balance_cv metrics
risks: Packed dispatch requires careful index tracking for scatter/gather correctness
May expose load imbalance if expert capacity varies significantly
Additional sorting overhead for token ordering (typically negligible vs communication savings)
